name: Lythrum

project_scope.source: Master Plant Pool and Lythraceae family module, 2026-10-14
project_scope.status: genus lesson only; both species not manifest-backed
project_scope.note: Source-pool admission is separate from native-range certification. Do not install taxa or count as native from this genus module.

look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: find a mature flowering shoot and compare leaf width and placement on its lower versus upper nodes. Both have slender raceme-like upper flowering axes and a persistent narrow floral tube. L. californicum usually has more open branching, gray-glaucous foliage and very narrow upper leaves (often linear, 1–7 mm wide); L. alatum tends to have less uniformly linear leaves and conspicuous stem angles or wings. Turn one flower sideways to inspect the floral tube and epicalyx; do not identify by purple flower color.
shared_genus_traits: Wetland or moist-soil perennial herbs with simple entire leaves; lower leaves may be opposite and upper leaves alternate.

Small flowers borne singly or in small groups along elongated leafy flowering axes; each flower has a narrow persistent floral tube (hypanthium), six stamens in the project pair, and a superior ovary.
Dry many-seeded capsules mature inside the persistent floral tube. Flowers can have differing relative style and stamen lengths (distyly); one flower view does not represent all morphs.

species_comparison_matrix.character: Upper leaf width and outline — primary
species_comparison_matrix.alatum: Often oblong to lanceolate, variable across varieties; not uniformly threadlike.
species_comparison_matrix.californicum: Upper blades mostly linear or linear-oblong; FNA reports 7–60 × 1–7 mm across positions.
species_comparison_matrix.how_to_check: Photograph 5 fully grown lower and upper leaves on a ruler; do not use one reduced bract.

species_comparison_matrix.alatum: Often relatively less open, but variable.
species_comparison_matrix.californicum: Often more open with much distal branching.
species_comparison_matrix.how_to_check: Whole flowering shoot including main axis and branches; use only in combination with leaf morphology.

species_comparison_matrix.californicum: Ridged or angled stems may occur; not an exclusive character.
species_comparison_matrix.how_to_check: Macro of mid-stem cross-section/angles; never use wings alone.

species_comparison_matrix.alatum: Cylindrical tube, measure against regional key; overlap expected.
species_comparison_matrix.how_to_check: Side-on intact flower macro with mm scale, show base to sepals; avoid conflating petal length and tube length.

species_comparison_matrix.alatum: Often around 3–7 mm in regional descriptions, variable.
species_comparison_matrix.how_to_check: Measure intact flat petal; overlap makes this secondary.

species_comparison_matrix.alatum: Distyly occurs in native Lythrum; check multiple flowers.
species_comparison_matrix.how_to_check: Compare flower centers across individuals; do not key species solely by style length.

species_comparison_matrix.alatum: Many-seeded capsule inside persistent floral tube.
species_comparison_matrix.californicum: Capsule splits septicidally or septifragally; seeds numerous.
species_comparison_matrix.how_to_check: Attached ripe capsule and dissected seed/valve view; genus confirmation, not primary species split.

quick_key: 1. Verify Lythraceae by the persistent tubular floral cup around a superior ovary, rather than treating the cup as an inferior ovary.
2. Check multiple upper stem leaves: very narrow linear blades and open glaucous branching support L. californicum.
3. Broader variable lanceolate leaves with strongly 4-angled/winged stems support L. alatum; check infraspecific variation.
4. Measure floral tube, petals, epicalyx and mature fruit with magnification; if characters conflict, retain Lythrum sp. and request a regional-key review.

genus_diagnostics.look_here_first: Whole shoot → upper leaf blade with scale → side-on floral tube → epicalyx/sepals → mature capsule.

shared_structure_examples.plain: A narrow cup-like tube around the flower's seed-forming ovary.
shared_structure_examples.photo_role: side-on intact flower with petals and sepals visible
shared_structure_examples.where_to_look: Follow the narrow tube from the stalk to the sepal teeth.
shared_structure_examples.why: Shared genus/family clue; compare its length and shape without confusing it with the pedicel.

shared_structure_examples.plain: Small pointed projections near the mouth of the floral tube.
shared_structure_examples.photo_role: flower base macro at 10× with mm ruler
shared_structure_examples.where_to_look: Count true sepal tips and alternating accessory projections separately.
shared_structure_examples.why: Useful regional-key structures, not obvious in a distant flower photo.

shared_structure_examples.plain: Leaves lower on a shoot can come in pairs while higher leaves occur singly.
shared_structure_examples.photo_role: complete shoot plus two successive leaf-node close-ups
shared_structure_examples.where_to_look: Photograph lower and upper nodes on the SAME shoot.
shared_structure_examples.why: Shared pattern; upper leaf width is more useful for the two-species comparison.

shared_structure_examples.plain: Dry fruit with many small seeds, enclosed by the old floral tube.
shared_structure_examples.photo_role: attached mature capsule and dissected fruit
shared_structure_examples.where_to_look: Trace the capsule back to the persistent floral cup.
shared_structure_examples.why: Reinforces Lythraceae identification after petals fall.

teaching_order: Photograph full flowering shoot and upper/lower leaves.
Measure multiple upper leaf blades, not tiny bracts.
Compare branch openness and stem angles, with overlap caution.
Turn one flower side-on; identify floral tube, sepals and epicalyx.
Follow a fruit into maturity; verify capsule inside persistent tube.
study_strategy.warning: FNA explicitly notes problematic intermediates between L. alatum varieties and L. californicum, including in eastern Texas. Do not turn upper-leaf width or purple flower color into a single-character absolute key.

comparison_cards.title: Narrow upper leaves versus broader variable leaves
comparison_cards.look_here_first: L. californicum tends toward linear upper blades 1–7 mm wide; L. alatum is often less uniformly linear.
photo_requirements: same-scale complete upper shoots and upper leaves of both species
comparison_cards.caution: L. alatum var. lanceolatum can approach californicum; verify a regional key.

comparison_cards.title: The floral tube is not the stalk
comparison_cards.look_here_first: Identify the persistent tube with sepal and epicalyx tips; distinguish from the short pedicel.
photo_requirements: matched side-on flower bases, mm scale and fruiting tube
comparison_cards.caution: Petal length and tube length overlap; verify both species using more than one character.

comparison_cards.title: Lythrum versus Ammannia and Rotala
comparison_cards.look_here_first: Lythrum has more conspicuous flowers along slender flowering axes; Ammannia has small axillary cymes and often auriculate leaf bases; Rotala ramosior has tiny axillary flowers and tapered leaf bases.
photo_requirements: matched Lythrum flower axis and Ammannia/Rotala node-flower views
comparison_cards.caution: Do not infer genus from color or leaf arrangement alone; check floral tube and fruit.

local_lookalikes.why_confusable: Wetland herbs with small flowers and persistent floral tubes.
local_lookalikes.separate: Ammannia tends to small axillary cymes and often auriculate clasping leaves; compare intact nodes and mature capsules.

local_lookalikes.why_confusable: Small wetland Lythraceae with opposite leaves.
local_lookalikes.separate: Tapered leaf bases and very small solitary axillary flowers; check mature floral tube.
Dense showy spikes versus more open native project pair; verify taxon before invasive labeling or range decisions.

diagnostic_photo_checklist.need: Whole shoot plus 5 measured mature upper blades per species; ruler and node positions.
Same-scale branching architecture and stem angle/wing close-ups.
Side-view floral tubes with scale, separate sepal and epicalyx tips; future arrows annotation_pending.
Clear flower-center views across individuals; avoid inferring morph from one obscured flower.
Attached fruit and opened capsule with seeds, ruler and attribution.
